Unsafe Haven

By: Liz Fish | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Guardian angel or exploitative old people farmer?

Unique Selling Point:
Charmaine Pereira - is she a saint providing desperately needed accommodation and a safe haven for destitute old people or is she “farming” the aged? She runs a squatter camp for old people on land owned by the Mamre community, a Moravian mission 45 minutes outside Cape Town. Setting herself up in 2014 inviting people to come settle on the “farm” where they could put up their own shacks. She promised to provide 3 meals a day and water and ablutions.An ideal retirement plan for those living on SASSA grants.

Summary:
Over the years through donations a central hall with a big cooking fire and donkey boiler showers and porta loos have been built, but the toilets are in a shocking state and do not get “serviced” regularly. There is no electricity and she gives people 25l of water a week which she collects from Mamre. She doesnt pay for the water. People have to build their own shacks or Wendy houses and when they leave she keeps and gives them to new comer. She has recently constructed pallet and plastic structures for single people living in 1m by 2m spaces. She registered an NPO and fund raisers through her facebook page called “Lilly Rose Community farms” and every time she posts pictures of the old volks the donations come flooding in.

Further information:
When people move in, if they are cripple she removes their SASSA cards. Once a month she provides transport for the old volks to withdraw their SASSA grants and they must hand over R1400 in cash. Recently she described it as donations, initially it was rent. But she demands the full amount leaving the old volks with R500 to but toiletries and gas. There are now about 160 people squatting there which means she makes close on R200 000 a month. If people have private pensions she charges R2000 some are paying R4000. She is extremely verbally abusive to everyone, and we have voice recording of her screaming at people. All the food she provides if from donations form 4 nearby Checkers of expired food. People regularly have upset stomachs and Imodium is an essential to survive this food. We have pictures showing the expiry dates on bacon and mouldy bread.
When they got the additional R250 COVID grant she insisted they give her R140 of it over and above the R1400. She has first pickings of donations which she keeps for her family and puts the leftovers out on a table for the old volks to help themselves. They have to line up and take one item at a time off the table and then join the back of the que with Charmaine controlling the process. She also controls who is allowed to shower, and how often, they are lucky if its twice a week.
When Natalie- one of the residents arrived 4 years ago after responding to a Gumtree Ad of inviting people to settle on her farm, Charmaine had just one TATA bakkie with the charity branding. Now she has 4 vehicles including a ew double cab. She recently bought a farm nearby which she says is from the inheritance from her mother. On the new farm she runs a shop selling off the donations. She plans to move the core group of loyal “followers” to her new farm and has threatened to leave the ”trouble makers” behind and burn down anything left there. There are about 20 people who now refuse to pay rent to her for land they are squatting on as it belongs to the Mamre Community Property Association. They now get no water, food and are not allowed to use the ablutions.
The Mamre Association can do nothing about evicting them under COVID regulations and are concerned that she is exploiting and further impoverishing people. They say if the food donations stop they will assist they just want her gone. Charmaine son has beaten up people in the past and she pays the workers on the “farm” between R50 and R100 a week, 3 packets of cigarettes and the expired food.

An investigation into her NPO compliance and whether she has paid her income tax for all the cash she takes off these people will form part of the investigation. She doesn't use EFT, she works in cash

Script:


Script: 50 kilometres outside Cape Town, down a sandy track in a farming area near Mamre, lies an informal settlement established and run by Charmaine Pereira, for the destitute aged. She is using her charity, Reaching out to others, to get donations and food for the settlement, but conditions and care here, have raised serious questions.
Link: Living on SASSA pensions is extremely tough and there is not enough accommodation for the aged. So, when a charity says they will look after you, albeit in a basic settings it sounds ideal, but is this an unsafe haven
Script: Nic Carney and his partner Natalie, had reached the end of the road financially, and with nowhere else to go, paid R2400 for a 3x3 shack, including food and water.
Natalie: But we were not told that the land didn't belong to her, that we would be squatting because the ad said “by the owner”. And also, we didn't know we were going to be eating waste food.
Script: Pereira moved here in 2014, getting permission from the local Chief Zama to farm pigs. Then she advertised, painting a quaint picture of a rustic rural life. When Carney arrived 4 years ago, there were about 30 people, with no ablutions apart from three long drops. Now the camp has an estimated 150 people, only two flushing soak away toilets, and one donkey boiler shower- all donated
Derek: would you say that this is operating as a non-profit organization helping the poor and aged?
Nic No, I think it's Charmaine Pereira helping yourself.
Script: Carney estimates that if there are 150 people living there, and 30 aren't paying, she is making R150 000 a month, plus the donations of furniture and building materials, which she is selling off for cash
LINK The farm is down this sandy track about 1.5 kms from the road. There no electricity or running water and some of the residents are disabled without transport, they pretty much depend on Pereira’s good will
“JANE”if you're good, if you're submissive, you may enjoy transport, you might just get to the clinic, you might get to the shops. But if you don't listen to her …you staying put
Mike/Louis: I just cannot believe and understand how any human being can abuse and mistreat old and vulnerable people that have got nowhere to go and they are being treated like total total, miss useless animals, shouted at screaming at sworn at
LINK What’s disturbing is how many people wanted their identities hidden for fear of having their homes removed or being dumped at the side of the road
Robert She tells people at the table fuck and if you a lady joe moer and all that kind of Shit
Script: The residents have to pay R1340 of their R1890 SASSA pensions, leaving under R500 for toiletries, beverages, medicines and cooking gas. Pereira provides 25 litres of drinking water a week. Private pensioners pay far more, Dennis pays R2000 for a 2X3 shack with no window.
We had sent in a hidden camera to investigate, and were talking to residents when we encountered Pereira
Charmaine: Good morning. How are you? Did you ask me if you can take a photo of me? You can be rude and so can I be rude
Derek:. Chairman my name is Derek Watts Carte Blanche and I'd like to speak to you on camera. About your charity Roto and the situation here at this informal settlement,
Charmaine: Now that I can work with, thank you I am thank you
Script: Most residents she introduced us to assured us they were very happy, and grateful to not be on the streets.
Man” And this has been fantastic
woman: where would we be able to go for the amount of money, the food that we get the clothes that we get, the blankets that we get, we don’t need anything we don’t want to go out into the outside world
Script: We managed to get Charmaine to show us the kitchen where some old people’s food is prepared
Derek “ But it does look like a bit of a mess
Charmaine “I don’t think it’s a mess my work girls have not come in ..the 1st week of the month they drink
Script: Charlotte was making lunch for the old residents, the rest must fend for themselves with the waste food which arrives at the end of the day. The food varies greatly, and can be anything from leftover Deli food like chicken and fish, to baked goods. Collected from various supermarkets about 50 kms away, it’s driven around in the sun all day. Then it's sorted, but the residents claim the best food gets taken off the farm.
Natalie People have to stand in long queues. You select one item, then you have to be shouted at to go to the back of the queue. If you dare take one extra, ….and it's old people queuing for the item.
Nic: Sometimes it's food that we probably couldn't afford otherwise. But it's all past it sell by date.
Derek: Some people say they're getting sick because of the food.
woman: I never got sick in 12 years, nonsense.When I was working in a full time job that I couldn't even afford to buy that I get here and there's nothing wrong with it
Charmaine Its surplus food, it’s not animal food it’s not waste like it used to be long ago. What's not edible for human consumption gets thrown for the pigs
Derek: Charmaine some residents claim that you are farming the elderly and homeless.
Charmaine: Not at all. I'm providing them with a service. to run a place like this costs money. We need vehicles. Pensioners get taken to clinics, to hospitals. They get taken to do their shopping. They get cared for. We put up homes and workers. Well, I don't employ workers. I give them a bikkie kos because you know what they got in they drug.
Script: In fact there about 10 people working on the farm, getting between R60 and R100 a week, none are professionally trained to care for frail aged
Derek: some residents of the informal settlement say that you and your family are pocketing massive profits.
Charmaine: I'm not pocketing anything, I've got nothing to hide
Derek: But the residents say that money is predominantly paid in cash or directly into your personal bank account. Yes That's correct. No receipts, given 00:07:37:22 they don't need a receipt everyone pays
Derek: So right now, you can't show us any records at all
CHarmaine: Right now To be quite honest with you, my records aren't up to date.
Script: Her registered charity is not compliant- she hasn't submitted books since 2017, and the majority of the board are close family, which is’nt permitted. The situation is murky, because although she collects food and raises donations using her NPO, she insists the settlement isn't run under the NPO
Charmaine:. This is a private entity that I'm doing I'm not using my NPO
Jo. We have a community of almost one thousand five hundred and backyard dwellers. And here you have someone coming from outside and you put up a community making as if that land belongs to you 00:01:25:17And in the same time, also then abusing people while you there
Script. Jo Cooper, chair of the Mamre residents association, believes the land was allocated to Mamre under the restitution process. Residents demanded Pereira leave, and despite her lawyer admitting she is squatting, Pereira is standing her ground
UPSOUND Charmain- you need a court order
Derek: Apparently, Pereira has permission from Chief Zama
Jo: We don't know Chief Zama and we never met him. He doesn't live in Mamre at all. He doesn't have the right, wherever he lives, he does have the right to give land away.
Script: It’s become a political football – Pereira’s attorney Carlo Viljoen of the separatist Cape Freedom Party, accused the DA run City of Cape Town of victimising white squatters after a site inspection.
Link: The City of Cape Town and social services visited the site last year and their report raised several issues - but it’s out of their hands because this land is under national government and all the City is required to do is deliver enough drinking water, which they do
Script. Now a rebel group of about 20 people have stopped paying after the Mamre residents told them to, as she has no more rights than they do as squatters. Pereira has cut them off from the donated food, water and ablutions
Derek: Why do you abuse the pensioners who should be treated with dignity
Charmaine: now, who told you I abuse them? Many people, many people …I them, if I'm stern, sometimes
“YOUR F MENTALITY IS WARPED- SUBTITLE
Charmaine we swear here a lot of us swear.
Script: But many live in fear, her 23 year old son, a board member, was charged with assault for allegedly beating up this 59 year old resident. Both were apparently drunk at the time.
Charmaine : he acknowledged it and he apologized about it over Facebook. He's never denied it, he said it in his testimony as well
Script: Through his lawyers, however, her son denied the assault and said the charges were withdrawn after he presented evidence from witnesses that backed up his version.
Pereira realised she can’t stay here indefinitely, so she has acquired a farm and plans to move the compliant residents there
LINK; This is the new property called Lilly Rose Community Farm where Pereira’s family is living and where she plans to move people to, but the authorities say it’s agricultural land and will have to be rezoned
Script: She openly admitted to selling off donated building material, clothes and furniture for cash from this shed, but had no financial records for public scrutiny.
Jane: Whatever you donate, 90 percent of it, even if you deliver it to the farm does not reach the destitute pensioner.
Derek: Charmaine, what is your plan for people living here? Because this is what we hear?
Charmain said that as they move out she's going to burn down the place to supposedly leave it like before someone ever lived here.
Charmaine What I have said is that I will take every one of our rooms that we have built here over with us to the other side
Script: But residents who built and paid for their own homes like Natalie, claim they were forced to sign this document giving Pereira ownership if they leave, this argument went down shortly before we arrived.
Derek: Quite a fight, I just said that to antagonise her
Charmaine : Well, we get verbal.
Derek: So is this a business? Do you see the problem? You had no financial records money going into your private account, family members as board members
Script” And when the food truck arrived, she was riled and wanted to throw us out. It’s a huge amount of food collected daily, much of it is removed off site. The different factions believe there is plenty for the Hawks to investigate with Pereira’s cash deals and sale of donations, no audited books, and the vehicles and farm in various family members' names.

Link: The City of Cape Town and social services visited the site last year and their report raised several issues - but it’s out of their hands because this land is under national government and all the City is required to do is deliver enough drinking water, which they do Script. Now a rebel group of about 20 people have stopped paying after the Mamre residents told them to, as she has no more rights than they do as squatters. Pereira has cut them off from the donated food, water and ablutions Derek: Why do you abuse the pensioners who should be treated with dignity Charmaine: now, who told you I abuse them? Many people, many people …I them, if I'm stern, sometimes “YOUR F MENTALITY IS WARPED- SUBTITLE Charmaine we swear here a lot of us swear. Script: But many live in fear, her 23 year old son, a board member, was charged with assault for allegedly beating up this 59 year old resident. Both were apparently drunk at the time. Charmaine : he acknowledged it and he apologized about it over Facebook. He's never denied it, he said it in his testimony as well Script: Through his lawyers, however, her son denied the assault and said the charges were withdrawn after he presented evidence from witnesses that backed up his version. Pereira realised she can’t stay here indefinitely, so she has acquired a farm and plans to move the compliant residents there LINK; This is the new property called Lilly Rose Community Farm where Pereira’s family is living and where she plans to move people to, but the authorities say it’s agricultural land and will have to be rezoned Script: She openly admitted to selling off donated building material, clothes and furniture for cash from this shed, but had no financial records for public scrutiny. Jane: Whatever you donate, 90 percent of it, even if you deliver it to the farm does not reach the destitute pensioner. Derek: Charmaine, what is your plan for people living here? Because this is what we hear? Charmain said that as they move out she's going to burn down the place to supposedly leave it like before someone ever lived here. Charmaine What I have said is that I will take every one of our rooms that we have built here over with us to the other side Script: But residents who built and paid for their own homes like Natalie, claim they were forced to sign this document giving Pereira ownership if they leave, this argument went down shortly before we arrived. Derek: Quite a fight, I just said that to antagonise her Charmaine : Well, we get verbal. Derek: So is this a business? Do you see the problem? You had no financial records money going into your private account, family members as board members Script” And when the food truck arrived, she was riled and wanted to throw us out. It’s a huge amount of food collected daily, much of it is removed off site. The different factions believe there is plenty for the Hawks to investigate with Pereira’s cash deals and sale of donations, no audited books, and the vehicles and farm in various family members' names. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Guardian angel or exploitative old people farmer?
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Charmaine Pereira - is she a saint providing desperately needed accommodation and a safe haven for destitute old people or is she “farming” the aged? She runs a squatter camp for old people on land owned by the Mamre community, a Moravian mission 45 minutes outside Cape Town. Setting herself up in 2014 inviting people to come settle on the “farm” where they could put up their own shacks. She promised to provide 3 meals a day and water and ablutions.An ideal retirement plan for those living on SASSA grants.
metadata.Summary: Over the years through donations a central hall with a big cooking fire and donkey boiler showers and porta loos have been built, but the toilets are in a shocking state and do not get “serviced” regularly. There is no electricity and she gives people 25l of water a week which she collects from Mamre. She doesnt pay for the water. People have to build their own shacks or Wendy houses and when they leave she keeps and gives them to new comer. She has recently constructed pallet and plastic structures for single people living in 1m by 2m spaces. She registered an NPO and fund raisers through her facebook page called “Lilly Rose Community farms” and every time she posts pictures of the old volks the donations come flooding in.
metadata.Further information: When people move in, if they are cripple she removes their SASSA cards. Once a month she provides transport for the old volks to withdraw their SASSA grants and they must hand over R1400 in cash. Recently she described it as donations, initially it was rent. But she demands the full amount leaving the old volks with R500 to but toiletries and gas. There are now about 160 people squatting there which means she makes close on R200 000 a month. If people have private pensions she charges R2000 some are paying R4000. She is extremely verbally abusive to everyone, and we have voice recording of her screaming at people. All the food she provides if from donations form 4 nearby Checkers of expired food. People regularly have upset stomachs and Imodium is an essential to survive this food. We have pictures showing the expiry dates on bacon and mouldy bread. When they got the additional R250 COVID grant she insisted they give her R140 of it over and above the R1400. She has first pickings of donations which she keeps for her family and puts the leftovers out on a table for the old volks to help themselves. They have to line up and take one item at a time off the table and then join the back of the que with Charmaine controlling the process. She also controls who is allowed to shower, and how often, they are lucky if its twice a week. When Natalie- one of the residents arrived 4 years ago after responding to a Gumtree Ad of inviting people to settle on her farm, Charmaine had just one TATA bakkie with the charity branding. Now she has 4 vehicles including a ew double cab. She recently bought a farm nearby which she says is from the inheritance from her mother. On the new farm she runs a shop selling off the donations. She plans to move the core group of loyal “followers” to her new farm and has threatened to leave the ”trouble makers” behind and burn down anything left there. There are about 20 people who now refuse to pay rent to her for land they are squatting on as it belongs to the Mamre Community Property Association. They now get no water, food and are not allowed to use the ablutions. The Mamre Association can do nothing about evicting them under COVID regulations and are concerned that she is exploiting and further impoverishing people. They say if the food donations stop they will assist they just want her gone. Charmaine son has beaten up people in the past and she pays the workers on the “farm” between R50 and R100 a week, 3 packets of cigarettes and the expired food. An investigation into her NPO compliance and whether she has paid her income tax for all the cash she takes off these people will form part of the investigation. She doesn't use EFT, she works in cash
